title: Tax rates and the standard rate cut-off point
text:
There are two tax rates in Ireland for personal income: a standard rate and a higher rate.

The standard rate applies up to your standard rate cut-off point. Any income above that point is taxed at the higher rate.

For a single person, widowed person or surviving civil partner without dependent children, the standard rate cut-off point is EUR 42,000 for the 2025 tax year. Income up to this amount is taxed at 20%, and any income above this amount is taxed at 40%.

For married couples or civil partners with one income, the standard rate cut-off point is EUR 51,000. For married couples or civil partners with two incomes, the standard rate cut-off point is EUR 84,000, with a maximum increase of EUR 33,000 depending on the lower income.

For a single parent qualifying for the Single Person Child Carer Credit, the standard rate cut-off point is EUR 46,000.

These figures are illustrative sample data used for development and testing of this application. Always confirm current rates on revenue.ie.
